chunks: And from him, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
When the Muslim kills a Jew, or a Christian, or a Magian, so they intend that they retaliate, they have to return the excess wergild to the (guardians of the) Muslim, and retaliate him.

key_terms.دِيَة: Blood money or compensation for death/injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on blood money when a Muslim kills a Jew, Christian, or Magian?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi articulates the principle of 'partial qisas' (qisas with compensation) in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from the Sunni view of 'equal qisas' where a Muslim is killed for a Zimmi. It clarifies that while the life of the Muslim is not forfeited entirely, the financial disparity between the higher blood money of a Muslim and the lower blood money of a Zimmi is settled by returning the surplus to the Muslim's heirs, thereby balancing justice with the hierarchy of souls.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ibn Muskan, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘When the Muslim kills a Jew, or a Christian, or a Magian, so they intend that they retaliate, they have to return the excess wergild to the (guardians of the) Muslim, and retaliate him’.
